historical_results_policy: Preserve original computational tables separately. No historical number or TRAIN-derived diagnostic fills a new final-result cell.

blocks.title: Cohort and source support

blocks.title: Training and reproducibility

blocks.title: Exact assembly across all families

blocks.title: Decoder and chemistry repairs

blocks.required_artifacts: policy/code pins, original/proposed/final graphs and all stage costs
